thread:
Rafael (Acme): Hey @support — after our pinned model upgrade our search returns an embedding-length error on our vector DB. Happened after we pinned a version and later we saw a backend variance.
Maya (Support): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the exact error and the model name you're calling?
Rafael (Acme): Error from our ingestion job: `embedding length mismatch: expected 1536 but got 1024` when upserting to Weaviate. We're calling model `redwood-embed-large@2025-11-15`, but I see a new model variant `redwood-embed-large-v2` rolled out.
Maya (Support): Got it. Two quick checks: 1) can you confirm the model string in your API call (full name + tag)? 2) the raw response shape from our /v1/embeddings call (no post-processing) — just the length of the vector per item.
Rafael (Acme): here's the curl we use:
````
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large@2025-11-15","input":["hello","world"]}'
````
and the response snippet (trimmed):
````
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,0.002,...],"index":0},{"embedding":[...],"index":1}]}
````
When we count, we get 1024 floats.
Jonah (Eng Runtime): Thanks — that lines up with an internal alias change. The model tag `@2025-11-15` you pinned was automatically mapped to a runtime bundle that, after a subsequent rollout, started serving a quantized v2 variant with 1024 dims. We did not change the public alias, but the backend bundle swapped. I'm going to grab the mapping.
deploy-bot: deploy-event: "bundle/redwood-embed-large/v2 -> promoted to default" at 2026-01-28T03:12:45Z
Sophia (ML Ops): Quick note: some customers pin to the alias alone (no tag) and rely on us not swapping bundles; pinned tags should prevent this but the customer's pin referenced the alias plus date which our pinning logic interpreted as a compatibility hint — looks like we have a bug.
Maya (Support): Rafael — short-term fixes:
- If you need immediate compatibility, change your call to a model variant known to be 1536-dim: `redwood-embed-large-legacy@2025-09-01` (we can confirm exact tag).
- Re-ingest vectors using the new 1024-dim vectors and update your index.
- If you want us to rollback the mapping for your org, we can open a Dedicated pin rollback; needs eng approval.
Rafael (Acme): Could you confirm the model metadata endpoint? I tried `GET /v1/models/redwood-embed-large/metadata` and got back `{"embedding_size":1024}` which confused me because our docs show 1536.
Jonah (Eng Runtime): Confirmed. We've updated the model metadata for the alias after the v2 promotion. That is expected for the current default. The pinned tag should have kept the old metadata but due to the pin-parsing bug it didn't. We're treating this as a P1 for the pinning subsystem.
Maya (Support): I've asked for an internal ticket and attached Rafael's logs. Rafael, can you share the minimal repro with `model: <full-tag>` if you can — that'll let us test rollback faster.
Rafael (Acme): Pasted in #private — thanks. One more Q: batch sizes during embed upserts might have masked the problem earlier (we were batch upserting 100k docs in 1024-chunks). Any risk of partial writes?
Sophia (ML Ops): If your ingestion code slices arrays by predicted dimension and truncates/expands silently it's risky. The DB will reject the vector shape; partial writes depend on the DB client. We recommend validating shape before upsert and failing fast. Also we will add a warning to the API when model metadata changes.
Jonah (Eng Runtime): Action items for us:
- Repro the pin parsing bug and identify which pin forms are affected.
- Provide rollback path per org.
- Emit deprecation/warning headers in the embeddings response when alias metadata changes.
Maya (Support): Logged ticket INF-4231 and escalated to Eng Runtime + ML Ops. I'll post updates here.
Rafael (Acme): Thanks — appreciate the quick triage. ETA on rollback?
Jonah (Eng Runtime): Can't promise immediate rollback until we have a safe path; expecting a 48–72h window for org-scoped rollback after we verify tests. Will keep you posted.
Maya (Support): Marking this resolved for now as triage/esc. Reopen if you see new errors after applying suggested mitigations. :thumbsup:
